eyebrow: T-SQL for Database Administrators · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 11 · Index & Statistics Administration

code:
SELECT OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) AS table_name,
       i.name AS index_name,
       ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent,
       ips.page_count
FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(
  DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, 'LIMITED') AS ips
JOIN sys.indexes AS i
  ON ips.object_id = i.object_id
 AND ips.index_id = i.index_id
WHERE ips.index_id > 0
ORDER BY ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent DESC;
caption: 'LIMITED' scan mode is safe to run in production during the day.

code:
SELECT OBJECT_NAME(ips.object_id) AS table_name,
       ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent,
       ips.page_count
FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(
  DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, 'LIMITED') AS ips
WHERE ips.index_id > 0
  AND ips.page_count > 1000
ORDER BY ips.avg_fragmentation_in_percent DESC;
caption: Fragmentation on a handful of pages barely changes real I/O patterns.
